humanFixture.source: Existing medium-attack audit four relative loops, reused unchanged, cyclic order1..4 then repeat; waypoint reach18 world units
humanFixture.stop: Stop at human ELIMINATED exactly like practice; no immunity, human respawn, input or rule changes
humanFixture.comparison: Mechanical repeated input is not the observed skilled human30%; report death-censored horizons rather than inventing2–3min figures

cost.warmup: Discard one seed19 replay per arm
cost.order: Alternate arm order by round+seed index
cost.aggregation: Median of three complete8-seed rounds; all48 samples retained; observer/HUD off

protocol.change: Only holdings>=64 and observed heads0: retain original candidates then add one larger variant per anchor/direction/shape with original random geometry shifted+2/+1; all old safety/score/period/rules unchanged
protocol.deathAnalysis: Read-only same resolved runs: pre-neutralization holdings, killer type/personality, cause, actual current goal/trail length, active and last expansion plan
protocol.referenceTarget: Human1+BOT13 at180s: leading bot>=20% auxiliary only; report human censoring/input limitations; not a sole acceptance gate

definitions.loss: Pre-neutralization holdings; fatal capture may prune ownership before death, so captures/theft/other live loss are separately accounted. Bin attribution is descriptive, not a causal experiment.
definitions.plans: Current goal and actual exposed cells at death; active expansion and same-life last expansion separately recorded. Last large loop does not imply it caused death.
definitions.TV: Mean of seed-level EXPAND/SEEK_POINT alive-goal total variation. Steal/reclaim use historical tick-boundary definitions; exact same-life enemy/neutral recovery separately retained.
definitions.human: Fixed existing four loops, stop at human elimination. Not a replay of a skilled player reaching30%. No180s value when eliminated earlier; missing is not zero.
